scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - NURSES' STATION - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - NURSES' STATION - NIGHT
Twenty-four-year-old night-shift nurse Harper frantically clicks her computer screen, where an unauthorized lethal potassium dosage is logged under her username.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Someone used my login to order fatal heart medication for eighty-one-year-old Evelyn Whitmore.
Seventeen-year-old Mia adjusts the sling supporting her injured left arm as she steps closer to her panicked older sister.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Harper, hospital security is walking down the hall right now with Cole's stepmother.
Twenty-nine-year-old sales executive Jake Whitmore steps between Harper and the corridor, placing a protective hand on Harper's shoulder.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Let me handle Diane, Harper, but you need to ask yourself why your supposedly broke mechanic husband was outside Evelyn's room right before the IV was tampered with.
Thirty-two-year-old Cole Hayes rushes into the intensive care unit, standing beside his grandmother's cardiac monitor.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Harper didn't touch this IV line, and I won't let anyone frame my contract wife.
Fifty-eight-year-old board member Diane Whitmore steps out from behind the curtain, holding a signed nurse activity log.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: The digital audit proves your fake nurse bride injected the toxin into my mother-in-law's drip to steal the Whitmore inheritance.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - NIGHT
Hospital guards grab Harper by the arms as Jake steps in front of her.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Leave Cole and marry me instead, Harper, and my legal team will wipe this murder charge clean before his secrets destroy you.
Two police officers cuff Harper's wrists behind her back as Cole bursts out of the ICU room to stop them.
